Date: 02nd November 2026 
 
 
To 
Listing Department 
BSE Limited  
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers  
Dalal Street  
Mumbai – 400 001 
To
Listing Department 
National Stock Exchange of India 
Limited 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G 
Bandra Kurla Complex 
Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400 051 
Script Code: 544633 
Trading Symbol: VIDYAWIRES 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 
Subject: Intimation of Earnings Call Invite for the second quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the Company will hold an 
earnings call with investors and analysts on Thursday, 05th November 2026 at 02:00 P.M. (IST).  
 
The call will be organised by IDBI Capital Markets & Securities Ltd. During the call, the Company’s 
management will discuss the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, 
followed by an interactive question-and-answer session with participants. 
 
Please note that the earnings call schedule is subject to change in the event of any exigencies. The 
earnings call invitation is enclosed with your information and records. 
 
The Company does not propose to disclose any unpublished price sensitive information during the 
earnings call. 
 
Please take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Vidya Wires Limited 
 
 
_______________________ 
Jaya Ashok Bhardwaj 
Company Secretary and Compliance Officer 
A37912 
BHARDWAJ 
JAYA ASHOK
Digitally signed by 
BHARDWAJ JAYA 
ASHOK

IDBI Capital Markets and Securities invite you all  
for post result earnings call of Vidya Wires Limited 
The management of Vidya Wires Limited plans to hold Q2FY27 result earnings call with 
analysts and investors on Thursday, 05th November 2026 at 02:00 P.M (IST) following the 
announcement of financial results of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. 
The management team will be represented by: 

Mr. Shailesh Rathi, Managing Director

Mr. Naveen Pachisia, Chief Financial Officer
Details of the conference call are: 
Date 
Thursday, 05th November 2026 
Time 
02:00 PM (IST) 
To participate in the call, participants are requested to register with the help of the 
registration link given below:  
https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_mACxioP9RF-kQEtnW0haBA
For further information please contact: 
Sahil Sheikh 
Analyst, Metals &  Midcaps 
IDBI Capital Markets & Securities Ltd 
Email: sahil.sheikh@idbicapital.com
